title: Fix retry-of-retry dropping the original request
summary: When the job being retried was itself "try again on <job>", the reader brief must show the original request (followed through the chain, redacted) plus the retried job's own findings. Only the retry fix, as the user said; the review-1 answer is a separate job. Includes the three earlier review notes: CHANGELOG heading, a bare-refusal test, distinct A/B verdicts.

defaults_applied.how: A new lifecycle test for retry-of-retry and a unit test for the bare refusal.
Only the retry fix; the design-doc review answer is excluded.
Behavior criteria name the cargo commands the verifier can run.
CHANGELOG entry under a Fixed section placed after Added.

assumptions: The original request is found by following the retried job's 'try again on <job>' request back to the first non-retry request, with a cycle/depth guard.
The brief still shows the retried job's own retry phrase only through its findings; the original request replaces it as the carried request.
The review-1 answer in docs/design is out of scope, per the user's reply.

acceptance_criteria.text: A lifecycle test named retrying_a_retry_carries_the_original_request_redacted passes: A rejected, B ('try again on A') rejected, then 'try again on B'; the third reader brief contains A's original request (redacted) and B's findings. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle retrying_a_retry

In that test A and B have different verdict findings (distinct canaries), and the assertions require B's canary present and A's absent. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle retrying_a_retry
Existing try-again tests still pass, including landed/unknown refusal and plain retry. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle try_again
A test covers bare 'try again on' being refused with the 'say which job' message. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-core reading
Reader brief rendering tests still pass. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-context reader_brief
Formatting and lints are clean. Run: cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] has a '### Fixed' entry for the retry-of-retry fix placed after '### Added', leaving the existing review-1 bullet under Added.
docs/design/study-capability-m1.md and the review file are not changed.
